# schedule template event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:scheduleTemplateEvent`](gmeow-scheduleTemplateEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scheduleTemplateEvent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The template event from which occurrences are generated — the anchor event carrying title, location, participants, and duration. Functional: one template per schedule.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EventSchedule`](../classes/gmeow-EventSchedule.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:scheduleTemplateEvent`](gmeow-scheduleTemplateEvent.md) from [`gmeow:EventSchedule`](../classes/gmeow-EventSchedule.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single anchor event a schedule clones — the carrier of the recurring title, location, participants, and duration that every occurrence inherits.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one (it is functional — one template per schedule) and avoid pointing it at a generated occurrence; the template is the pattern, not an instance of the series.

### How to use

- Set exactly one template [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); the occurrence engine combines it with each [`gmeow:scheduleRecurrenceRule`](gmeow-scheduleRecurrenceRule.md) to mint the [`gmeow:scheduleOccurrence`](gmeow-scheduleOccurrence.md) events.

### Examples

- ex:standupSchedule [`gmeow:scheduleTemplateEvent`](gmeow-scheduleTemplateEvent.md) ex:standupTemplate.
